Method of Attack: Remote code execution via maliciously crafted images sent through iMessage
Zero-click attack chain (BLASTPASS) involving specially crafted images in iMessage PassKit attachments to install spyware
Impacted Systems: iOS devices including iPhone 6s models, iPhone 7, first generation iPhone SE, iPad Air 2, fourth generation iPad mini, seventh generation iPod touch
macOS Ventura, macOS Monterey, macOS Big Sur
Attack Vector: Malicious images sent via iMessage PassKit attachments
